description: A Python script demonstrating various methods of building and running Kivy applications, including using build() methods, kv files, kv directories, language strings, and prebuilt widgets. It also includes command-line interface logic to select and run different app configurations.

classes.name: TestBuildApp
classes.description: An App subclass that builds a Button widget in its build() method.

classes.name: TestKVFileApp
classes.description: An empty App subclass intended to load a .kv file named after the class.

classes.name: TestKVDirApp
classes.description: An App subclass with a specified kv_directory for searching .kv files.

classes.name: TestKVStringApp
classes.description: An App subclass that creates a widget from a Kivy language string in build().

classes.name: TestPrebuiltApp
classes.description: An App subclass that uses a prebuilt widget defined via Builder.load_string and a nested class Prebuilt.

classes.name: Prebuilt
